The Schott Perfecto! The most legendary jacket of all time teams up with 3Sixteen, one of the best modern high quality clothing companies of this GENERATION. I feel like I should be hitting a buzzer like one of those BAM BAM BAAAAAAM air horn things.

Is the leather jacket a loud and crazy piece? Oh yes. Was it made popular by the 50's baddies such as James Dean, Marlon Brando, and Elvis Presley? Oh yes. Is now some nerd in his apartment making a video on a specific one? Yes and that is possibly the least cool thing you could do with a leather jacket. So the perfecto or double rider or motorcycle jacket went out of popularity for a bit. Of course some people will say it never can go out of style which is true but it can come in and out of the spotlight. That was until Hedi Slimane brought the heat with his Saint Laurent biker jacket (made from lamb or cow I think) that the double rider really ROARED back into popularity.
